usage: 蛋撻 (daan6 taat1) is a noun used to refer to the popular Hong Kong egg tart dessert.
You can use 蛋撻 in sentences to talk about eating, buying, or liking egg tarts.
When asking for 蛋撻, you can say '我要一個蛋撻' to order one egg tart.
This word stays the same whether you are talking about one or many egg tarts; context or number words tell you the quantity.
In casual conversation, 蛋撻 can also be a topic when discussing favorite dim sum items.
